title: ToolGate: Contract-Grounded and Verified Tool Execution for LLMs
evidence_locator: ACL Anthology abstract and bibliographic record; pp. 9653-9684
notes: Typed trusted key-value state plus Hoare-style pre/post tool contracts and runtime verification directly occupy broad verified-execution claims. No exact flagship epistemic contract.

title: Text2Mem: A Unified Memory Operation Language for Memory Operating System
evidence_locator: ACL Anthology abstract and bibliographic record; pp. 2105-2119
notes: Schema-based contracts with semantic invariants are parsed into typed operations and executed deterministically through SQL/reference backends. Closest typed-contract relational execution control in Q15.

title: LatentGate: Low-Latency Semantic Routing via Frozen-Backbone Probing of Small Language Models
evidence_locator: ACL Anthology abstract; 5 frozen SLM backbones; 100 enterprise agents; CLINC150
notes: Frozen-SLM routing is occupied; the lightweight probe is learned and the task is routing rather than trusted semantic-result placement.

title: Rethinking Scale: Deployment Trade-offs of Small Language Models under Agent Paradigms
evidence_locator: ACL Anthology abstract; less-than-10B open-source models; base vs tool-agent vs routing multi-agent paradigms
notes: Mandatory conventional baseline family for claims that small-model gains arise simply from agent/tool/routing scaffolds.

title: Guidelines as Environments: A World Model Approach to Rule Following
evidence_locator: ACL Anthology abstract; explicit evolving evidence state and inter-rule causal structure
notes: Occupies explicit-state handling of interacting/conflicting rules, but transitions are model-estimated and no exact four-state deterministic contract is present in the primary abstract.

title: Don't Offer What Can't Be Done: Deterministic Executability Gating for LLM Skill Selection at Scale
evidence_locator: arXiv abstract; deployed three-stage pipeline; 756.6K messages; 1000-conversation counterfactual replay
notes: Authoritative-state deterministic gating prevents impossible skills from reaching LLM selection. Strong routing/executability control but not epistemic truth/result rendering.
